mission: Define the architectural conformance contract by which certified Layers 00-15 semantics may be realized operationally without implementing a runtime, redefining predecessor authority, authorizing deployment or release, or executing an external action.

fixed_certification_boundary.category_1: A declared Layer 16 invariant is violated in a valid abstract realization history and the violation can permit a nonconforming realization or invalid authoritative outcome without first requiring failure of a deferred implementation mechanism.
fixed_certification_boundary.category_2: A physical implementation or runtime obligation explicitly allocated to a future owner class with prerequisites, evidence, and certification condition.
fixed_certification_boundary.category_4: Documentation or non-material reconciliation issue unable to permit a nonconforming realization or invalid authoritative outcome.

derivation_rules.object_schema: Project every object type field, authority, cardinality and prohibition without semantic addition or omission.
derivation_rules.transition_schema: Project every transition exactly from transition_rules.
derivation_rules.dag_node: Create one node for every object_type.
derivation_rules.dag_edge: Create one directed edge for each transition source type to its destination type.
derivation_rules.rank: Every edge must satisfy destination rank greater than source rank.
derivation_rules.documentation: May explain this model but may not add authority, mandatory predecessors, transitions, cardinalities, invariants or closure criteria.
derivation_rules.reconciliation: Compare projected object IDs and edge tuples for exact equality with this normative model.

invariants.text: Every Layer 16 requirement traces to an exact certified predecessor requirement or an explicit conformance-quality requirement within the fixed charter.
Layer 16 creates no predecessor, business, Human, evidence, decision, access, release, deployment, recovery or external-action authority.
Layer 14 remains the sole formal owner of protected-action runtime-enforcement semantics; Layer 16 creates no second runtime model.
Layer 15 remains the owner of consulting engagement, evidence-to-conclusion and non-executing handoff semantics.
Every realized Material object binds deterministic typed identity, canonical representation, exact version/hash, authority owner, boundary, provenance, lifecycle, freshness and revocation state.
Ambiguous serialization, parser disagreement, type confusion, noncanonical hashing or incompatible version interpretation fails closed.
Authoritative state and required audit evidence cannot diverge through partial, reordered or last-write-wins commitment.
Every exclusive successor, consumption or effect is protected in its certified global uniqueness domain; process-local idempotency is insufficient.
Stale writers, leases, fences, replicas, caches, sessions, approvals and projections cannot create a valid successor or effect.
Revocation, expiry, supersession and Material invalidation dominate cached, queued, retried, replicated and disconnected state; unknown currentness denies.
Runtime identity and attestation cannot broaden Layer 13 authority, substitute an actor, or represent a machine as a Human Principal.
Isolation preserves client, entity, engagement, jurisdiction, purpose and confidentiality boundaries across storage, processing, transport, backup, recovery and telemetry.
Unknown or partial effects reconcile authoritatively before retry, recovery or successor creation.
Recovery preserves immutable history, consumed authority, effect uniqueness, invalidation lineage and independent authorization; it cannot resurrect authority or duplicate effects.
Telemetry and audit are descendant evidence only and cannot create, repair, approve or certify authority or outcomes.
Deployment readiness, technical conformance and successful testing cannot imply deployment authorization, release authority or external-action authority.
A Layer 15 handoff remains non-executing and cannot become an instruction through representation, deployment, adapter interpretation or technical capability.
Every implementation deferral is explicit, owned by a future owner class, prerequisite-bound, evidence-bound, certification-bound and fail-closed when absent.
Future empirical certification is candidate-specific, independently performed and finitely convergent; aggregate scores and attack-count growth cannot cure a Material failure.
Every transition moves strictly forward in rank, every mandatory node is resolved and no derived or validation artifact becomes a competing normative source.
Missing, stale, conflicting, ambiguous, unverifiable, cross-boundary or inapplicable mandatory conformance input denies the affected specification.
